_meta.comment: Per-VRAM-tier default model selections for the installer's typed catalog UI. `tiers` maps a hardware tier (cpu, or the GPU VRAM budget in GB) to per-section default entry ids from catalog.json. The wizard resolves the tier from the detected GPU (nexus_installer/tier_defaults.py), fit-gates every id against detected VRAM and free disk, and pre-ticks the result; everything else in the catalog appears un-ticked for opt-in. v1.9.0 Phase 4: the agentic default is a Gemma 4 variant (Gemma 4 is agentic-coding-capable), so the agentic list is [<best-fitting Gemma 4 variant>, <coder fallback>] -- the Gemma is preferred and, because it is usually the same id as the chat pick, one model covers both chat and agentic; the coding specialist (qwen2.5-coder / deepseek-coder-v2) is the in-list fallback taken only when no Gemma 4 variant fits. v1.19.0 Phase 1: cpu agentic prefers LFM2.5-2.6B (the dedicated sub-4 GB tool-calling pick) ahead of Gemma / the 7B coder; the 8 GB list inserts LFM between Gemma and the 7B coder so sub-6 GB cards that cannot hold gemma4:e4b still get a dedicated agentic default; 12/16/24 keep the Gemma-preferred coder-fallback ordering. chat/agentic are single-pick sections; embed/image/audio/video take every fitting id. image/video defaults are the uncensored entries (the v1.8.0 product decision) on tiers whose hardware fits them; the cpu tier gets no image/video (diffusion requires a GPU). Audio defaults are the permissive, CPU-capable speech models (faster-whisper STT + Kokoro TTS) on every tier; the GPU-gated, non-commercial generation models stay opt-in.
